Forecast: Open-Meteo (CC BY 4.0), in Italy ICON-2I by ItaliaMeteo-ARPAE. Points rounded to about 1 km.

While you drive, the Eurise app asks Open-Meteo for the weather at up to 8 points of the road ahead, with the time you\'ll pass them. Points are rounded to about 1 km; nothing else leaves, no account and no phone identifiers. Open-Meteo sees those points, not who you are. Requests are listed in the Eurise privacy centre; you can turn it off here or there at any time.
